parent.title: A weekend at Les Prés d'Eugénie: walk to a 3-star dinner, day-trip the Tursan ring

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Les Prés d'Eugénie
siblings.summary: Eight character properties around Eugénie-les-Bains, from the on-estate 18th-century convent and rose-garden suites to Tursan manors, Armagnac estates and a riverside maison-de-maître in Aire-sur-l'Adour.

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Les Prés d'Eugénie
siblings.summary: Tursan and Chalosse day trips around Michel Guérard's Eugénie-les-Bains: bastides, vineyards, foie gras farms, Romanesque crypts and one greenway.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Les Prés d'Eugénie
siblings.summary: A 30 km radius around Les Prés d'Eugénie is a tech-event desert — only Mont-de-Marsan (26 km) hosts anything IT-flavoured, all weekday cybersecurity dates, none on a Saturday.

sources.title: La Maison Rose — Chaîne Thermale

sources.title: La Ferme aux Grives (official)
sources.claim: Logis des Grives: 4 suites 40–60 m² plus Deluxe rooms with terracotta tiles, beams, Arudy-stone bathtubs.

sources.title: Le Clos Nicolas (official)
sources.claim: 20 rooms + 6 suites, 400 m from the thermes.

sources.title: Le Clos Nicolas — TripAdvisor

sources.title: Chez Léonie — Aire/Eugénie tourism
sources.claim: 2-star family hotel, 11 rooms; doubles €65–72, opposite the thermes.

sources.title: Camping des Sources — Guide des Landes

sources.title: Les Prés d'Eugénie — Virtuoso
